notes.title: Turkish language support!
notes.content:
We've just pushed a build live that officially adds Turkish language support!  This translation was handled by the good folks at OyunÇeviri, who volunteered to handle it for us.

You can check out more info about their project here: http://www.oyunceviri.com/about-us/

notes.title: New languages now live!
notes.content:
We've added full support for a number of languages!  These will be detected automatically based on your system's current locale, or you can go to the game's properties in your library and pick a specific one if you like.  Anode now supports German, Spanish, Russian, Japanese, and Korean!

Big thanks to Elder for help with the Spanish translation!

This update includes a few other minor changes, notably the leaderboards support paging now.  Plus, we display the rank number for entries.

notes.title: Localization on its way!
notes.content: Look for an update in the next week or two adding new languages to the game!  Some other minor updates will come with it, including pagination for high score lists and labels showing exact rank!
